zh.summary: 每个人都有一个“私人空间”，当有人如此接近他们时，他们会感到焦虑。意大利研究人员在大阪和罗马进行实地调查发现，日本人有更多的个人空间，更喜欢与他人保持身体距离。阅读更多...

en.title: Japanese people have more personal space, revealed in a comparative experiment with Italians
en.summary: Everyone has a ``personal space'' where they feel anxious when someone approaches them this close. Italian researchers conducted field surveys in Osaka and Rome and found that Japanese people have more personal space and prefer to maintain physical distance from others. read more...

items.summary: カナダのオンタリオ州の刑務所では、2021年から逮捕歴や懲戒歴などの要素に基づいて受刑者にリスクスコアを割り当てるためのAIセキュリティ評価ツール「SAFER」が使われています。このSAFERが黒人受刑者に対して不当に高いリスクスコアを割り当てているとして批判を集めており、集団訴訟も提起されています。続きを読む...

zh.title: 加拿大安大略省因使用人工智能对囚犯进行分类的系统而被起诉，指控黑人囚犯被不公平地分配到高度安全的设施。
zh.summary: 自 2021 年以来，加拿大安大略省的监狱一直在使用人工智能安全评估工具 SAFER，根据逮捕和纪律历史等因素为囚犯进行风险评分。 SAFER 因给黑人囚犯分配不公平的高风险评分而受到批评，并且还提起了集体诉讼。阅读更多...

en.title: The Canadian province of Ontario has been sued over a system that uses AI to classify inmates, alleging that black inmates are being unfairly allocated to high-security facilities.
en.summary: Prisons in Ontario, Canada, have been using SAFER, an AI security assessment tool, since 2021 to assign risk scores to inmates based on factors such as arrest and disciplinary history. SAFER has been criticized for assigning unfairly high risk scores to black prisoners, and a class action lawsuit has also been filed. read more...
